Zara Petrov
zara.petrov@example.com | Charlotte, NC
Zara Petrov has 12 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Slate Labs (2022-2026), where they owned
the Kafka event pipeline processing 5M events/day. Before that, Senior Backend
Engineer at Lattice Technologies (2020-2022). Before that, Backend Engineer at
Amber Cloud (2019-2020). Before that, Software Engineer I at Driftwood
Analytics (2014-2019). Education: Ph.D. Software Engineering, Indiana
University, 2013; B.S. Software Engineering, University of Pittsburgh, 2007.
Core skills: PostgreSQL, Node.js, Docker, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, GraphQL,
REST API design, Kafka, AWS, Distributed systems, Python, TypeScript.
